name: issue_to_pr_delivery
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

child.description: code_parallel child report: deliveryOutcome/verificationState, proposalText, subtasks, merged, conflicts, totalTokens, totalCostUsd, deliveryRepairAttempts, deliveryReports, missingPaths, rejectedPaths, commandFailures, sandboxDenials. Non-object treated as empty.

publicationCommit.description: Merge/commit step report: commit (resolved SHA) and rejectedPaths. Non-object treated as empty.

workspaceState.description: Workspace state snapshot; its head is used as a commit fallback when publicationCommit has none. Non-object treated as empty.

fallbackCommit.description: Last-resort commit value used when neither publicationCommit.commit nor workspaceState.head is a non-blank string.

state.description: Delivery state; forced to incomplete_delivery when the child reported passed but the merge step still had rejected paths.

commit.description: Resolved delivery commit: publicationCommit.commit, else workspaceState.head, else fallbackCommit.

summary.description: Child's proposalText, or "Automated change." when not a string.

merged.description: Child's merged branch list, or empty.

totalTokens.description: Child's totalTokens, or 0 when not numeric.

totalCostUsd.description: Child's totalCostUsd, or 0 when not numeric.

repairAttempts.description: Child's deliveryRepairAttempts, or 0 when not numeric.

rejectedPaths.description: Union (deduplicated) of the child's rejectedPaths and the publication commit's rejectedPaths.
